title: Nyc South Asian Comedy Festival – Brown Unhinged. Uncensored South Asian Stand-up Comedy Show
description: Experience the Unrestrained Humor at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival – Brown Unhinged
long_description:
Experience the Unrestrained Humor at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival – Brown Unhinged
Get ready to laugh your heart out on the 17th of October, 2026 at the NYC South Asian Comedy Festival – Brown Unhinged. Presented by the hilariously talented Laughing Lassi, this uncensored South Asian Stand-Up Comedy Show is all set to tickle your funny bone. Delight in an evening of comedy, brimming with wit and humor, spiced with a dash of Hindi music. This unique blend of comedy and music is guaranteed to leave you in splits.
Presenting the Witty Maestros – The Artists
This extraordinary comedy spectacle is brought to you by a group of talented artists curated by Laughing Lassi. Each artist brings their unique style and background to the stage, offering a taste of South Asian humor that's both familiar and refreshingly original. Their ability to connect with the audience and bring everyday scenarios to life with a comedic twist is what sets this show apart. Get ready to see your world in a funnier light!
Laugh Out Loud at Broadway Comedy Club
The event will be held at the renowned Broadway Comedy Club, located at 318 W 53rd St, New York, NY, United States. Known for its safe and accessible location, the Broadway Comedy Club is a favorite among comedy lovers. Besides the top-notch comedy, the venue offers ample parking spaces and is surrounded by numerous Indian restaurants such as 'Bombay Grill' and 'Curry House', allowing you to enjoy a hearty meal before or after the show.
Secure Your Spot - Ticket Information
Places are filling up fast, so don't delay. Main Room - Standard tickets are available for just $25.00. This is your golden ticket to an evening of laughter, music, and unforgettable experiences. Book now and get ready to laugh like never before!
